name: v256_compact_buyback_option_share_residual
hypothesis: Buyback and operating-quality strength may be separable from option/share-dilution exposure by subtracting the call-put/share-count route and retaining option-volatility calm.
expression: 0.50 * (0.40 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(common_stock_buyback_payments / cap, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)) - 1.00 * (0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 252) / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)) + 0.75 * (0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry))

name: v256_compact_event_customer_residual
hypothesis: Legal/credit/M&A sentiment plus operating-quality reversal may survive after subtracting customer-authority exposure that frequently causes relationship-cluster self-correlation.
expression: 0.75 * (0.5 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.5 * rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126))) - 0.75 * (0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)) + 0.75 * (0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_merger_acquisition_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_credit_ratings, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_legal, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry))

name: v256_compact_event_goodwill_residual
hypothesis: Event/legal credit sentiment combined with intraday-operating quality may remain strong after subtracting the goodwill/cashflow quality sleeve that often overlaps classic balance-sheet quality.
expression: 1.00 * (0.5 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.5 * rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126))) - 1.00 * (0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * goodwill / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))) + 1.00 * (0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_merger_acquisition_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_credit_ratings, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_legal, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry))

name: v256_compact_earnings_fcf_receivable_residual
hypothesis: Earnings-evaluation sentiment and free-cash-flow value may form a low-correlation residual after subtracting receivable intensity, reducing overlap with basic quality and delivery alphas.
expression: 0.75 * (0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_earnings_evaluation_sentiment, 60), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)) - 1.00 * (0.65 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * receivable / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))) + 0.50 * (0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(free_cash_flow_reported_value / equity, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(net_profit_reported_value / equity, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry))

name: v256_compact_customer_page_profit_residual

expression: 0.50 * (0.5 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.5 * rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126))) - 0.75 * (group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)) + 0.50 * (0.450 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_page_rank, 60), industry) - 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry) + 0.210 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry))
